_comment: Adopter overlay-exemption config (see docs/adopter-guide.md). List your OWN private-overlay directory NAME(s) in extra_exempt_dirs to keep that top-level directory out of the gates that discover files through the shared toolchain helpers (which include the PII, secrets, and placeholder value-scanners and most corpus-integrity gates), without editing tool source. Each entry is a bare directory name matched TOP-LEVEL-ANCHORED and DIRECTORY-ONLY: it exempts only a directory of that name directly under the repository root, never a nested directory, and never a file of that name. A shipped corpus/tooling directory name (or an absolute/multi-segment/empty value) is rejected and skipped with a warning, so the config can NEVER blind a gate over shipped library content. IMPORTANT: a few gates run their OWN independent file discovery and may still scan your overlay and echo lines from it, so keep genuinely sensitive credentials out of the committed fork entirely rather than relying on this exemption alone. The shipped library carries an empty list.
